description: This file declares the WebAudioPlayerService class, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerService interface for managing web audio players within the Rialto server service. It includes method declarations for creating, destroying, controlling playback, and querying buffer and device info for web audio players, as well as managing internal web audio player instances with thread safety.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerService
classes.description: Implements IWebAudioPlayerService to manage web audio players, providing methods for creation, control, and cleanup, with internal thread-safe management of multiple web audio player instances.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new web audio player with specified handle, client, MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the web audio player associated with the given handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback on the specified web audio player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback on the specified web audio player.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets end-of-stream for the specified web audio player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the available buffer frames and shared memory info for the specified player.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames for the specified player.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer of the specified player.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the specified player.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level of the specified player.

methods.name: clearWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Clears all managed web audio players.
